title: Gathering Food
description: Help gather food for the hungry family

story: 👩 Edith: "Thank you so much for getting them both back.
I was wrong about you. You're a hero!"
👨 Edward: "Thank you so much for saving my little girl!
I have another favour to ask..."
"We haven't got any food. Could you gather some for us?
We didn't have time to grab any before we went into hiding."
"Do you remember seeing any food in your travels?"
...ah! You have all that food in your kitchen!
We could give that to this family.
Start by moving the basket to ~ (home).
steps.objective: Move the basket to the home directory
hints: Use the command 'mv basket ~/' to move the basket to the windy road ~

story: Now follow the basket. Use 'cd' by itself to go to the windy road ~.
hints: Use the command 'cd' by itself to move yourself to the road ~

story: You are now back on the long windy road. Look around with 'ls' to check that you have your basket with you.
steps.objective: Check that the basket is here
hints: Use 'ls' by itself to look around.

story: You have your basket safely alongside you, and you see my-house close by.
Don't forget to use the TAB key to autocomplete your commands.
steps.objective: Move the basket to the kitchen
hints: Use 'mv basket my-house/kitchen/' to move the basket to your kitchen.
